summary: Conservator Ilthalaine calls newly awakened night elves to tend Shadowglen’s wildlife. Young nightsabers and thistle boars have grown too numerous, and keeping Teldrassil’s natural harmony calls for stewardship and difficult choices.

sections.title: A Delicate Harmony
sections.body: In Shadowglen, beneath the Great Tree’s sprawling boughs, heavy spring rains have disrupted Teldrassil’s young, fragile forest cycle. Some wildlife populations have grown beyond what the land can sustain. They threaten to strip the glen of resources and bring famine to the ecosystem. Preserving the forest calls for active care.

sections.title: The Conservator's Call
sections.body: Conservator Ilthalaine watches over Shadowglen’s woods, keeping any one part from overtaking the others. To prevent mass starvation among the animals, he sends young night elves into the grove to thin thistle boars and predatory nightsabers. The work is unglamorous, but vital: kaldorei stewardship means seeking harmony with nature through active balance and difficult decisions.

faq.q: Why do the nightsabers and boars need to be killed?
faq.answer: Heavy spring rains caused young nightsabers and thistle boars to flourish. Shadowglen can sustain only so much wildlife, and the overgrown populations risk stripping the grove of food and starving themselves and other creatures.
Conservator Ilthalaine is a kaldorei guardian stationed in Shadowglen. His sworn duty is to watch the grove’s wildlife and vegetation so nature’s harmony remains intact.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: The task takes place in secluded Shadowglen, a forest enclave among the branches of Teldrassil, the World Tree off the coast of northern Kalimdor.

faq.q: What comes next after completing this task?
faq.answer: After this first part of the culling, Ilthalaine sends you to carry out its second part. He also gives you a class-specific sigil that points you to your first trainer in Aldrassil.

angles.text: As a night elf, this is your first step on the path to becoming an adult protector of the kaldorei. You learn that keeping nature in balance calls for active care and respect.
As a budding druid, you learn the harsh realities of Cenarion stewardship: protecting the wilds can mean shedding blood to save the whole.
As a hunter, you begin learning to track and cull aggressive wildlife, a foundation for communion with the beasts of Kalimdor.
